==Acquisition==
[[Seeker of Whispers]] in the [[Chantry of Secrets]] will award this skill for achieving the title of [[Lightbringer rank|Adept Lightbringer]].

==Notes==
*This skill can only target [[Lightbringer#Demonic Servants of Abaddon|demonic servants of Abaddon]]. It will [[fail]] against other foes, displaying a notice.
**However, the secondary hits from increased ranks in the title track can affect non-demonic enemies, e.g. Kournan soldiers, provided that the initial target was valid.
*[[Quickening Zephyr]] and [[Serpent's Quickness]] decrease the recharge time as well as disabling time of this skill.
{{anomaly|The holy damage from this skill is reduced by [[Armor rating|armor]].}}
{{anomaly|The animation for this skill is the same as a [[signet]].}}
{{anomaly|The additional foes are not interrupted.}}
